title: Monotonicity in the degree cutoff
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $\\varepsilon,a,b\\in\\mathbb R$ with $a\\le b$. If the sum of squared Fourier coefficients over coordinate sets whose size is strictly greater than $a$ is at most $\\varepsilon$, then the corresponding sum over sets whose size is strictly greater than $b$ is also at most $\\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
